after.text: The middle band contains larger grains; finer grains lie above and below. This core preserves their order, not their dates. The pictures do not yet tell us what moved the grains.
after.attribution: Fictional expedition field note; not a real mission measurement.

after.text: At this core site, a coarse band separates two fine-grained layers. We kept a labelled specimen. The saved ice profile is a comparison, not proof that the two places share an age or history. Nearby exposures may help us interpret the change.
after.attribution: Fictional expedition field note; not a real mission measurement.

after.text: The rounded gravel, preserved within its surrounding rock layers, supports transport by ancient water. The rippled surface alone does not establish a river. We have strengthened a water-transport interpretation, not dated these deposits or detected life.
after.attribution: Fictional expedition field note; not a real mission measurement.

after.text: Two sources remain separate on this board: the rippled surface and the gravel ledge. The gravel and its rock setting support an ancient-water interpretation more strongly than the ripple shape alone. Neither observation establishes life or a date.
after.attribution: Fictional expedition field note; not a real mission measurement.

after.text: Our paired record travels with its source labels intact. The gravel in its rock setting supports an ancient-water interpretation; the ripple impression alone does not prove a river. Keeping the specimens separate lets another team inspect our reasoning. We have not established an age or detected life.
after.attribution: Fictional expedition field note; not a real mission measurement.
